title: 重庆不是一座城市，是一座立体迷宫 | Chongqing: A City Built in 3D 🏙️
description:
在重庆，你被导航带迷路过吗？评论区聊聊。

有人说重庆没有平地——整座城盖在山和江之间。一栋楼的一楼，可能是别人的十楼；轻轨直接从居民楼里穿出来，李子坝站早在 2004 年就这样建了，是全国第一条跨座式单轨，列车穿楼只要八秒。想过江？坐索道，那是「万里长江第一条空中走廊」，当地人叫它「空中公交车」。爬坡上坎是日常，巷子深处一锅红汤在滚，老板一句「要得」就是成交。天黑了，洪崖洞亮起来，像《千与千寻》里的那座城。山不厌高，水不厌深——重庆把「难走」，走成了风景。

They say Chongqing has no flat ground — the whole city is wedged between mountains and the Yangtze. A ground floor here can be someone's tenth. At Liziba, a monorail bursts straight through an apartment block; the station was built like this in 2004, on China's first straddle monorail line, and the train clears the building in about eight seconds. To cross the river, you ride a cable car — "the Yangtze's first sky corridor," which locals call the sky bus. Climbing slopes is daily life; deep in an alley a pot of red hotpot boils, and "yào-dé" seals the deal. At dusk, Hongyadong lights up like the town in Spirited Away. Chongqing turned "hard to walk" into a view.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
